verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent-payment stack documents a signed-mandate consent model: users explicitly authorize scoped, time-boxed, revocable spending permissions (delegated wallet signers, order-intent card allowances) before any agent transaction executes, with onchain/network enforcement of the boundaries (crossmint-supp-2, crossmint-supp-4, crossmint-supp-8). Agent Checkouts also references letting the user 'steer the agent' during a checkout run, suggesting an interactive control layer beyond pure pre-authorization (crossmint-docs-50). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these consent/mandate mechanisms work as documented, and clearer detail on any per-purchase confirmation UI versus purely upfront delegation.
